standard.title: Interpret and adjust language for cultural contexts
standard.description: interpret and adjust non-verbal, spoken and written language to convey meaning in the target language in familiar and some unfamiliar cultural contexts
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can apply strategies to interpret and convey meaning — including managing non-equivalent expressions and creating bilingual resources (AC9LS6C04). They have not yet compared their own translations with others, interpreted context-dependent vocabulary, or created cultural responses for community audiences.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students interpret and adjust language to convey meaning in familiar and some unfamiliar cultural contexts — including translation comparison, context-dependent meaning, and cultural response production.

nodes.label: Context-dependent meaning and translation comparison
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can interpret words and expressions whose meaning varies by context, and compare their translations with others' — reflecting on the choices made.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify at least one word with context-dependent meaning and explain two different meanings; compare a translation with at least one other version and identify at least one difference.
nodes.typical_width: Interpret context-dependent expressions across varied text types; compare translations with classmates, noting similarities and differences; reflect on challenges of meaning transfer between languages; select and explain vocabulary that shifts meaning by context; interpret short messages and informal communications.
wider: Collect target language words with context-dependent meanings — produce a mini-guide showing each meaning with a sentence example
Translate the same short text individually then compare all translations — identify every decision point where versions differ and explain what caused variation
nodes.hinge_reason: Context-dependent meaning is a persistent comprehension challenge that produces systematic errors when unresolved. Students who do not recognise that words can shift meaning by context misread authentic texts regularly.

response_modes.reason: Context-dependent vocabulary awareness builds through accumulating examples across different word categories and contexts. A bank of examples builds the wariness that prevents automatic misreading.

success_criteria: Identifies at least one target language word with context-dependent meaning and provides two different meanings with examples
Compares a translation with another version and identifies at least one difference, explaining what caused it

nodes.label: Creating cultural responses and explanations
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can create informative responses to cultural representations — reviews, vlogs, explainers — that convey cultural meaning alongside content description.
nodes.minimum_width: Create at least one cultural response that explains at least one language or cultural element in terms of cultural associations — not only content description.
nodes.typical_width: Create informative responses to target language community cultural events, exhibitions or media; explain cultural associations of specific language or images; respond to authentic discussions about culture and language incorporating personal perspectives; present information from multiple source types on a topic of interest.
wider: Produce a critical review of a target language community cultural event — incorporating cultural analysis alongside personal evaluation
Create a bilingual cultural explainer for an Australian audience — making decisions about what requires cultural explanation for an audience with no target language background

response_modes.reason: Cultural response production integrates context-dependent meaning interpretation (N1) with cultural knowledge and production — students must interpret what cultural elements mean and then communicate that meaning to an audience.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Creating cultural responses for real or authentic audiences positions students as cultural mediators — where intercultural mediation becomes a genuinely valuable communicative role.
success_criteria: Creates a cultural response that explains at least one language or cultural element in terms of its associations — not only describes it
Incorporates personal perspective alongside cultural information
